description:
About our brand and products

Abani Rugs is a family-run home brand built on one idea: a great rug shouldn't cost a fortune or take six weeks to arrive. We design and import directly from our own manufacturing partners and ship from our own warehouses across the US and Canada.

Our catalogue spans machine-washable rugs, indoor/outdoor, jute and natural fiber, shag, and one-of-a-kind handmade pieces, in every size from 2'x3' accents to 10'x14' oversize, plus runners, rounds and squares. Styles run vintage and traditional through contemporary, farmhouse, coastal and geometric. We've also expanded into table lamps — ceramic, walnut, sculptural — for customers styling a whole room, not just a floor.

Rugs range from $30 to $750, with lighting around $198. Free shipping on orders over $99.

What makes us different

  • We're the importer, not a reseller. We own the supply chain from the loom to the warehouse shelf. That's why our pricing sits where it does — there's no middleman markup for your audience to pay.
  • Real inventory, in North America. We stock in the US and Canada, so orders ship fast. No drop-ship delays, no "arriving in 6–8 weeks."
  • Machine-washable is a core category, not an afterthought. This is the single easiest thing to sell to parents and pet owners, and we have depth in it.
  • One-of-a-kind handmade. Genuine single-piece vintage and handmade rugs for the audience that wants something nobody else has.
  • Easy returns and exchanges, plus real phone support at (800) 616-0014 — so your audience isn't taking a risk clicking your link.

How affiliates can earn

You earn 5% commission on every completed order placed through your unique tracking link.

  • Commission applies to the full order — if someone clicks your link for a $79 runner and checks out with a $400 oversize rug and a $198 lamp, you earn on all of it.
  • Commissions are applied and paid monthly, once the return window has closed.
  • Payment via PayPal.
  • No cap on earnings, and no excluded categories. Rugs, lighting, clearance — everything counts.

How to promote us

Whatever fits your audience — we'll support it:

  • Room reveals and before/afters. Rugs are the highest-impact, lowest-commitment change in a room. This content converts.
  • Round-ups and gift guides — "washable rugs for messy households," "outdoor rugs under $100," "runners for narrow hallways."
  • Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest. Pinterest in particular performs unusually well for rugs, and our catalogue is built for it.
  • Blog and SEO — size guides, "how to pick a living room rug," style comparisons.
  • Email newsletters to a home, design, DIY or parenting list.
  • Trade and design professionals — if you work with clients, ask us about our Trade Program alongside the affiliate program.

We'll provide product imagery, lifestyle photography and video, current promo codes, and a feed of new arrivals and clearance so your content stays current.

Other information

  • Free shipping on orders $99+; easy returns and exchanges.
  • We ship across the US and Canada.
  • Commission is paid on merchandise value, excluding shipping and taxes.
  • Returned or cancelled orders are deducted from commission.
  • Please disclose your affiliate relationship as required by FTC guidelines.
  • We don't permit bidding on our brand terms in paid search, coupon-site listings without approval, or any promotion using our name in a way that implies you're us.
  • Questions: info@abanirugs.com · (800) 616-0014
  • Follow us: Instagram @abanirugs · Pinterest · Facebook
payout_period: First of each month every 2 months.
